name: chiqq
description: Bulk load your async tasks to queue them with concurrency control and retry logic
author: Mathias Wulff

scripts.build: rm -rf dist types && bun run build-esm && bun run build-cjs && bun run build-types
scripts.build-esm: bun build src/index.ts --outfile dist/chiqq.js --format esm && rexreplace '^( {2})+' "'\\t'.repeat(€0.length / 2)" -jq dist/chiqq.js
scripts.build-cjs: cp dist/chiqq.js dist/chiqq.cjs && rexreplace '^export \{[^}]*\};?' 'module.exports = Object.assign(Chiqq, {default: Chiqq, Chiqq, ChiqqClearedError});' -q dist/chiqq.cjs
scripts.preversion: git diff-index --quiet HEAD -- || (echo 'Please commit all files or stash them' && exit 1) && bun install --frozen-lockfile && yarn typecheck && yarn test && npm login
scripts.version: yarn build && yarn test-dist && git add dist types
scripts.postversion: npm publish && git push && git push --tags && echo "Successfully released version $npm_package_version"
